item_name: Rothco Rip Stop Operator Tactical Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Rip-Stop Operator Tactical Cap is designed for durability and comfort, making it an essential accessory for outdoor activities, tactical missions, and everyday wear. Made from 100% cotton rip-stop material, this rugged baseball hat is built to withstand the toughest conditions while providing long-lasting wear. The tactical baseball cap features a loop area on the front panel, perfect for attaching flag, unit, or morale patches. Additionally, the outdoor hat features a loop patch on top for added customization.
description: Rothco’s Rip-Stop Operator Tactical Cap is designed for durability and comfort, making it an essential accessory for outdoor activities, tactical missions, and everyday wear. Made from 100% cotton rip-stop material, this rugged baseball hat is built to withstand the toughest conditions while providing long-lasting wear. The tactical baseball cap features a loop area on the front panel, perfect for attaching flag, unit, or morale patches. Additionally, the outdoor hat features a loop patch on top for added customization. With 4 reinforced vent holes, the tactical cap ensures optimal airflow, keeping you cool during intense activities. The hook & loop closure at the back allows for a secure and adjustable fit, accommodating most head sizes comfortably. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
